summary: A trash rule starts with a grace month, then fines, as rat complaints fall.
realLife: A city required food businesses to keep garbage in lidded containers and put it out late in the day. On the first day a reporter saw loose lids and bags beside bins, a worker said five bins were not enough, and a pizzeria manager said each bin cost about a hundred dollars. A month of warning came first, then fines that rose with each offense. The sanitation agency said rat complaints fell about a fifth over the summer.
sources: CBS News New York (New York City), 'Bins not bags: New trash rule takes effect for NYC restaurants, grocery stores & more', August 1, 2023: https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/newyork/news/bins-not-bags-new-trash-rule-takes-effect-for-nyc-restaurants-grocery-stores-more
